## Overview

This is a Spring PetClinic variant built on the **OfficeFloor** framework, where the create-owner REST endpoint is expressed as a YAML-defined pipeline of single-responsibility "function" classes. Household logic lives across the model, the mapper (for derived response fields), the create pipeline functions, the OpenAPI schema (which generates the DTOs), the DB schema, and one acceptance test.

Note upfront: there is a **discrepancy between the acceptance test and the current implementation** — details in the last section. This is almost certainly the change you'll be implementing.

---

## 1 & 2. Files referencing household / duplicate / membership, with code

### Create pipeline definition (OfficeFloor YAML)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`
This is the full create-owner pipeline. Order of steps: `validate → checkCityCapacity → checkDailyLimit → build → assignHousehold → checkIdentity → assignHouseholdSize → assignCustomerCode → assignNamesakeCount → assignBulkSignupWarning → assignPossibleDuplicate → save → audit → respond`. Household is assigned at step `assignHousehold` (before `checkIdentity`, so householdId is part of the identity key), household size after identity check, and possible-duplicate soft-match just before save. Full contents already shown above; the inline comments document the intent of `checkIdentity` and `assignPossibleDuplicate`.

### AssignHousehold (householdId generation/assignment — see section 5)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignHousehold.java`
Full body shown above. Key points:
- Opt-in only: returns early unless `request.getSharesHousehold()` is TRUE.
- Household key = normalized **lastName + address** (not postcode).
- Reuses an existing housemate's householdId if present, else derives via `deriveHouseholdId(lastName, address)` = `"HH-"` + first 8 bytes of SHA-256 over `lastName + "|" + address` as uppercase hex (16 hex chars).
- Back-fills the shared householdId onto existing housemates and saves them.
- `normalize()` = trim + collapse whitespace + lowercase.

### AssignHouseholdSize
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignHouseholdSize.java`
Full body above. Counts existing owners sharing the new owner's householdId, +1 for the new owner; null householdId → size 1.

### AssignPossibleDuplicate (soft-match duplicate detection)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignPossibleDuplicate.java`
Full body above. Flags `possibleDuplicate=true` + `possibleDuplicateOf=<lowest matching id>` when an existing owner shares lastName (case-insensitive) + postcode but has a *different* telephone. Null postcode never matches.

### CheckOwnerIdentityUnique (hard duplicate detection → 409)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/CheckOwnerIdentityUnique.java`
Full body above. Rejects when the whole `IdentityKey.of(owner)` equals an existing owner's. HouseholdId is part of that key.

### IdentityKey (household is a key segment)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/IdentityKey.java`
Full body above. Key = `normalizedTelephone + "|" + email + "|" + householdId` (null segments empty).

### MembershipLevel
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/MembershipLevel.java`
Full body above. `of(owner)`: start 1; +1 if email present; +1 if `namesakeCount==0`; capped at MAX=3 (level 4 reserved for tenure). Used only in `OwnerMapper` (`membershipLevel` response field) and `AuditOwnerCreated` (audit log).

### OwnerIdentityConflictException
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/escalation/OwnerIdentityConflictException.java`
Full body above. Carries the identityKey; handler responds 409. Registered as an OfficeFloor escalation at `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.escalation.OwnerIdentityConflictException.yml`.

## 3. Tests referencing household / sharesHousehold / duplicate / membership

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` — the only functional test, and it is entirely about household. Full contents shown above. It asserts:
- Two owners with the same lastName + postcode get the **same** householdId.
- A different lastName (same postcode) gets a **different** householdId.
- Comment states householdId is "deterministic from (lastName, postcode) alone."

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` — support harness (no household logic itself). Relevant helpers: `ownerNode()` (line 117, minimal valid owner, no postcode, no sharesHousehold), `withPostcode()` (129), `createOwnerOk()` (160), `fetchOwner()` (200), `uniqueLastName()` (79). Line 37/43/194 mention "membership"/"duplicate" only in prose.

No unit tests exist for the individual function classes.

---

## 4. Where owners are created (endpoint + pipeline)

- **Endpoint/pipeline YAML:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` (maps to `POST /api/owners`, requires `hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`).
- **Function classes** (all in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`), in pipeline order:
  1. `ValidateOwnerFields.java`
  2. `CheckOwnerCityCapacity.java`
  3. `CheckOwnerDailyLimit.java`
  4. `BuildOwner.java` (maps DTO→entity via `OwnerMapper.toOwner`, defaults/adjusts registrationDate to a business day via `BusinessDay.adjust`)
  5. `AssignHousehold.java`
  6. `CheckOwnerIdentityUnique.java`
  7. `AssignHouseholdSize.java`
  8. `AssignCustomerCode.java`
  9. `AssignNamesakeCount.java`
  10. `AssignBulkSignupWarning.java`
  11. `AssignPossibleDuplicate.java`
  12. `SaveOwner.java` (calls `ownerRepository.save`)
  13. `AuditOwnerCreated.java`
  14. `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java`

Supporting: `BusinessDay.java`. Data flows between functions via OfficeFloor `@Val`/`Out` variables (`OwnerFieldsDto request`, `Owner owner`/`built`).

---

## 5. How householdId is currently generated/assigned

Entirely inside `AssignHousehold.service(...)` (see section 1). Summary:
- **Opt-in gate:** only runs if the request's `sharesHousehold == true`; otherwise householdId stays null.
- **Match key:** normalized lastName + normalized address (lowercase, trimmed, collapsed whitespace).
- **Reuse-or-derive:** reuse an existing housemate's non-null householdId; else derive deterministically as `"HH-" + SHA-256(lastName + "|" + address)` first 8 bytes as uppercase hex → e.g. `HH-3F2A9C1D` (16 hex chars). Existing housemates are back-filled and re-saved.
- Column: `household_id VARCHAR(64)` in both `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/db/h2/schema.sql` and `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/db/hsqldb/schema.sql` (also mysql/postgres schema files exist).

---

## 6. DTOs involved

DTOs are **generated at build time** from the OpenAPI spec (no hand-written `OwnerDto`/`OwnerFieldsDto` in the source tree; they land under `target/generated-sources` in package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`). The source of truth is:

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`
- **`OwnerFields`** schema (request side, ~lines 2000-2081): firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone, email, postcode, registrationDate, birthDate, and **`sharesHousehold`** (line 2067, `writeOnly: true`, boolean — the household opt-in flag). Required: firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone.
- **`Owner`** schema (response side, `allOf` OwnerFields + read-only fields, ~lines 2082-2244): id, displayName, initials, customerCode, checkDigit, membershipNumber, **`householdId`** (2139), namesakeCount, **`membershipLevel`** (2159, min 1 max 3), locality, contactPreference, ageBand, bulkSignupWarning, identityKey (2206, `normalizedTelephone|email|householdId`), **`possibleDuplicate`** (2216), **`possibleDuplicateOf`** (2225), pets.

Mapper wiring: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` (MapStruct). `toOwnerDto` computes the derived response fields via expressions, including `membershipLevel` → `MembershipLevel.of(owner)` (line 25), `identityKey` → `IdentityKey.of(owner)` (line 29). `householdId`, `possibleDuplicate`, `possibleDuplicateOf`, `householdSize` map straight from the entity fields. `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` ignores id and pets.

Entity: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — persistent columns `householdId`, `householdSize`, `possibleDuplicate`, `possibleDuplicateOf`, `customerCode`, `namesakeCount`, `bulkSignupWarning` (lines 64-83, getters/setters 144-198). Note the entity has no `sharesHousehold` field — it exists only on the request DTO.

---

## Important discrepancy to be aware of before implementing

The single acceptance test (`AcceptanceTest.coreSameLastNameAndPostcodeShareHouseholdId`) does NOT match the current `AssignHousehold` implementation:

1. **Opt-in vs always-on:** Test owners `a` and `c` never set `sharesHousehold`, yet the test expects each to have a non-null `householdId`. Current code returns early and leaves householdId null unless `sharesHousehold == true`. (`.get("householdId").asText()` on a missing/null node would not produce a real hash.)
2. **postcode vs address:** The test's stated contract and assertions key the household on **(lastName, postcode)**. Current `deriveHouseholdId` keys on **(lastName, address)** — and `ownerNode()` generates a unique address per owner, so even two same-lastName owners would currently derive *different* ids.
3. `assertNotEquals(ha, hc)` relies on different lastName → different id, which holds under either scheme, but hinges on householdId being populated for non-opting owners.

So the likely intended change: make householdId always assigned and derive it deterministically from (lastName, postcode) rather than gating on `sharesHousehold` and keying on address. This would touch `AssignHousehold.java` primarily, and possibly the doc comments in `owners.POST.yml`, `IdentityKey.java`, the `openapi.yml` descriptions for `sharesHousehold`/`householdId`, and `AssignHouseholdSize` semantics.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted in national or
            international form (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored) and stored
            and returned in E.164 form: a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits. A national
            number with no country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading
            '0' dropped, so '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. When true, the create request is allowed even if
            another owner already has the same last name and address; otherwise
            such a duplicate is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:

        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8
                is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY
                is the last two digits of the registrationDate year (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26').

              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household (owners
                with the same last name and address who opted in via sharesHousehold).
                Assigned when an owner joins an existing household; null otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A9C1D5E6B7A8C'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the moment this owner was created,
                sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
                Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation. Starts at 1;
                add 1 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, taken from the REGION segment of the customerCode (the
                region-and-hash identity, derived from the postcode). 'UNKNOWN' when no
                region could be derived. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band at the moment of registration, derived from birthDate

                64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string

              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:

                registration business day at the moment this owner was created; false
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single value all duplicate detection is expressed through, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId are empty
                when absent). A create is rejected with 409 only when its whole identityKey
                equals an existing owner's. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F2A9C1D5E6B7A8C'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing
                owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a different telephone; false
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean

                postcode, different telephone) when possibleDuplicate is true; null
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted in national or
            international form (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored) and stored
            and returned in E.164 form: a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits. A national
            number with no country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading
            '0' dropped, so '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. The householdId is derived deterministically from the
            owner's last name and postcode, so owners sharing both are the same
            household. When true, the create request is admitted as a declared member
            of that household (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate); otherwise
            a second owner in an existing household is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8
                is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY
                is the last two digits of the registrationDate year (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26').
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household (owners
                with the same last name and address who opted in via sharesHousehold).
                Assigned when an owner joins an existing household; null otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A9C1D5E6B7A8C'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the moment this owner was created,
                sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
                Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation. Starts at 1;
                add 1 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, taken from the REGION segment of the customerCode (the
                region-and-hash identity, derived from the postcode). 'UNKNOWN' when no
                region could be derived. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band at the moment of registration, derived from birthDate
                measured against registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to
                64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration business day at the moment this owner was created; false
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single value all duplicate detection is expressed through, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId are empty
                when absent). A create is rejected with 409 only when its whole identityKey
                equals an existing owner's. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F2A9C1D5E6B7A8C'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing
                owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a different telephone; false
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one softly matches (same lastName and
                postcode, different telephone) when possibleDuplicate is true; null
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
